Commute time: center and spread通勤时间：中心与离散程度

A tutor wants to describe five student commute times. Follow the fixed data from question to calculation to a conclusion with the correct scope.一位教师希望描述五名学生的通勤时间。沿固定数据逐步明确问题、进行计算并作出适用范围恰当的结论。

Data and calculator assumption数据与计算器假设

Synthetic educational data created for this course: 10, 12, 12, 14, 17 minutes. No external observations or real student records.本课程编制的合成教学数据：10、12、12、14、17 分钟；不含外部观测或真实学生记录。

Assumption: TI-84 Plus CE, OS 5.7, MathPrint, STAT WIZARDS ON. Text values below are rounded transcriptions, not exact screen formatting.假设：TI-84 Plus CE，OS 5.7，MathPrint，STAT WIZARDS ON。下列数值为四舍五入的文字转录，不表示屏幕的精确排版。

This is a worked process, with rounded numeric transcriptions. It is not a calculator emulator or screen image. Conceptual checks are labeled separately.这是逐步讲解，数值为四舍五入后的文字转录，并非计算器模拟器或屏幕截图。概念核验单独标注。

Use ← and → to step. Printing includes every step in the selected language.使用 ← 和 → 逐步浏览。打印时显示所选语言的全部步骤。

1. Define the question1. 明确问题

Conceptual setup概念设置

Question: What are the center and variability of these five commutes?问题：这五个通勤时间的中心和离散程度如何？

Minutes: 10, 12, 12, 14, 17分钟：10、12、12、14、17

These are five synthetic students, not a random sample of a school. Describe these five only.这是五名合成示例学生，并非学校的随机样本；结论仅描述这五人。

2. Enter the data2. 输入数据

TI-84 keys and setupTI-84 按键与设置

MODE → STAT WIZARDS: ON. STAT → 1:Edit. Highlight L1 header → CLEAR → ENTER (do not use DEL). Enter 10 ENTER 12 ENTER 12 ENTER 14 ENTER 17 ENTER.MODE → STAT WIZARDS: ON。STAT → 1:Edit。选中 L1 列名 → CLEAR → ENTER（不要用 DEL）。依次输入 10 ENTER 12 ENTER 12 ENTER 14 ENTER 17 ENTER。

L1 = {10,12,12,14,17}; five rows, no other entriesL1 = {10,12,12,14,17}；共五行，无其他数据

Clearing the column prevents old observations from entering the analysis. All measurements have the same unit: minutes.清空整列可避免旧观测混入分析；所有测量单位均为分钟。

3. Choose one-variable statistics3. 选择单变量统计

TI-84 menu and wizardTI-84 菜单与向导

STAT → right arrow to CALC → 1:1-Var Stats → ENTER. List: L1 (2nd 1); leave FreqList blank. Down arrow to Calculate → ENTER.STAT → 右箭头至 CALC → 1:1-Var Stats → ENTER。List 设为 L1（2nd 1）；FreqList 留空。下箭头至 Calculate → ENTER。

List = L1; FreqList = blankList = L1；FreqList = 空白

Each listed observation is counted once. Do not put the commute values in a frequency list.每个观测计数一次；不要把通勤时间填入频数列表。

4. Read and check the center4. 读取并核验中心

TI-84 numeric transcription + independent checkTI-84 数值转录与独立核验

Read x̄, Σx, Σx² and n in the results; scroll down for Med.读取结果中的 x̄、Σx、Σx² 和 n；向下滚动查看 Med。

n = 5; Σx = 65; Σx² = 873; x̄ = 13 min; Med = 12 minn = 5；Σx = 65；Σx² = 873；x̄ = 13 分钟；Med = 12 分钟

Independent check: (10+12+12+14+17)/5 = 13; the middle sorted observation is 12. The mean exceeds the median because the higher values pull the mean upward.独立核验：(10+12+12+14+17)/5 = 13；排序后的中间值为 12。较高值把均值向上拉，因此均值大于中位数。

5. Distinguish the two standard deviations5. 区分两种标准差

TI-84 numeric transcription + independent checkTI-84 数值转录与独立核验

Read Sx and σx. Use Sx when reporting a sample standard deviation.读取 Sx 和 σx。报告样本标准差时使用 Sx。

Sx ≈ 2.64575131 min; σx ≈ 2.36643191 minSx ≈ 2.64575131 分钟；σx ≈ 2.36643191 分钟

Squared deviations sum to 9+1+1+1+16 = 28. Sx = √(28/4); σx = √(28/5). The denominator changes; the data do not.离均差平方和为 9+1+1+1+16 = 28。Sx = √(28/4)；σx = √(28/5)。分母不同，数据相同。

6. Interpret within the design6. 在研究设计范围内解释

Conceptual conclusion概念结论

Report the quantity, units, and scope.报告统计量、单位及适用范围。

For these five synthetic commutes: mean 13 min, median 12 min, sample SD about 2.65 min.这五个合成通勤时间的均值为 13 分钟、中位数为 12 分钟、样本标准差约为 2.65 分钟。

The sample SD describes a typical distance from the mean in minutes. These data do not justify a claim about every student or about what causes commute time.样本标准差描述观测值偏离均值的典型距离，单位为分钟。这些数据不足以推断所有学生，也不能说明通勤时间的因果关系。
